events.name: Chicago Cubs at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Major League Baseball moved a regular-season series finale between the Red Sox and Chicago Cubs from Fenway Park to Tropicana Field in St. Petersburg, Florida, because of a weekend storm threat in the Boston area.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cubs-Red Sox series finale moved to Florida amid storm threat in Boston

events.name: Baltimore Orioles at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Pete Alonso homered twice to take over the American League lead with 43, including a 471-foot drive deep into the left field bleachers, and the Baltimore Orioles routed the New York Yankees 10-2 in a doubleheader opener on Friday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pete Alonso homers twice to take over AL lead as Orioles rout Yanks 10-2 in doubleheader opener

events.name: Chicago Cubs at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Wilyer Abreu hit a two-run double in the eighth inning, and the Boston Red Sox beat the Chicago White Sox 2-0 Friday night to sweep a doubleheader.
headlines.shortLinkText: Red Sox beat Cubs 2-0 to sweep doubleheader after setting Wild Card Series matchup with Yankees

headlines.description: — Spencer Torkelson finished a single short of the cycle, Jackson Jobe allowed two runs in 5 1/3 innings and the Detroit Tigers beat the Pittsburgh Pirates 8-7 on Friday night after nearly wasting a six-run lead.
headlines.shortLinkText: Torkelson narrowly misses cycle as Tigers hang on to beat Pirates, 8-7

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Philadelphia Phillies

headlines.description: — Freddy Peralta pitched into the sixth inning to help Tampa Bay deny Philadelphia a third straight shot at clinching a wild-card spot, as the AL East champion Rays beat the Phillies 2-0 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rays' Freddy Peralta shuts down punchless Phillies, who lose 3rd straight potential playoff clincher

events.name: New York Mets at Washington Nationals

headlines.description: — The high-spending New York Mets were assured their first last-place finish since 2003, losing to the Washington Nationals 7-6 on Friday night as Josiah Gray earned his first major league save in his first home appearance in more than two years.
headlines.shortLinkText: High-spending Mets assured of first last-place finish since 2003 with 7-6 loss to Nationals

events.name: Cincinnati Reds at Toronto Blue Jays

headlines.description: — Nathan Lukes hit a go-ahead single in a four-run seventh inning, Kazuma Okamoto had two hits and three RBI, and the Toronto Blue Jays rallied to beat the Cincinnati Reds 6-5 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lukes has go-ahead hit in four-run seventh, Okamoto drives in three as Blue Jays beat Reds 6-5

headlines.description: — Eury Pérez pitched a one-hitter for just the 11th complete-game shutout in the major leagues this season, and the Miami Marlins beat the playoff-bound Atlanta Braves 3-0 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pérez throws 1-hitter for just 11th MLB complete-game shutout this year as Marlins beat Braves 3-0

events.name: Baltimore Orioles at New York Yankees
Cleveland Guardians at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — José Ramírez, Chase DeLauter and Petey Halpin drew consecutive bases-loaded walks in a five-run ninth inning capped by Angel Martínez's two-run double, and the Cleveland Guardians beat the Kansas City Royals 12-9 Friday night to maintain a one-game...
headlines.shortLinkText: Guardians maintain 1-game AL Central lead, beat Royals 12-9 with help from 6 walks in 5-run 9th

events.name: Colorado Rockies at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Munetaka Murakami homered twice to increase his season total to 35, and the playoff-bound Chicago White Sox beat the Colorado Rockies 6-1 on Friday night as they tried to gain ground in the AL Central.
headlines.shortLinkText: Munetaka Murakami homers twice as playoff-bound White Sox top Rockies 6-1

events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at Milwaukee Brewers

headlines.description: — Brice Turang delivered a tiebreaking two-run single in the eighth inning for his third hit of the game as the Milwaukee Brewers defeated the St. Louis Cardinals 8-4 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brice Turang hits go-ahead single in eighth inning as Brewers defeat Cardinals 8-4

headlines.description: — Jacob deGrom matched a career high by allowing eight earned runs on Friday and the Texas Rangers stumbled again in the AL West race with a 10-2 loss to the Minnesota Twins.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rangers falter in AL West chase, lose to Twins 10-2 as deGrom matches high by allowing 8 earned runs

events.name: Arizona Diamondbacks at San Diego Padres

headlines.description: — Nolan Arenado hit one of Arizona's three home runs and Geraldo Perdomo drove in four runs for the Diamondbacks, who beat San Diego 11-4 on Friday night to remain alive for the National League's final wild-card spot.
headlines.shortLinkText: Arenado, Perdomo lead Diamondbacks over Padres 11-4 to stay alive in wild-card hunt

headlines.description: — Henry Bolte and Michael Stefanic both drove in two runs in the sixth inning, and Jacob Lopez tossed four strikeouts in the Athletics’ 6-5 win over the Houston Astros on Friday, assuring the AL West champion will be baseball’s first postseason team...
headlines.shortLinkText: Bolte and Stefanic each hit 2 RBIs in sixth to lift Athletics past Astros 6-5

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Seattle Mariners

headlines.description: — Reid Detmers pitched six shutout innings, Wade Meckler finished a home run short of the cycle, and the Los Angeles Angels beat the Seattle Mariners 7-5 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Detmers throws 6 shutout innings as the Angels beat the Mariners 7-5

events.name: Los Angeles Dodgers at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Teoscar Hernández and Andy Pages hit home runs in the second inning to back Tarik Skubal's three-hit, seven-inning performance, and the Los Angeles Dodgers beat the San Francisco Giants 2-0 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Teoscar Hernández, Andy Pages hit home runs, Skubal strikes out 10 as Dodgers beat Giants 2-0
